narrative.intro: AMI Metals recorded $2B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. AMI Metals received 9 awards so far, with an average award size of $225M and obligations up 4136383.9% year over year. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $2B to AMI Metals, while the Department of Defense accounted for $13.5K. Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services represented $2B in obligations for AMI Metals, with Other Support Activities for Air Transportation at $13.5K. Historical obligations for AMI Metals were $9.8K in FY21, $165K in FY22, $109K in FY23, $346K in FY24, and $48.9K in FY25. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date).
